Parchment is a local-first terminal application for notes, documents,
spreadsheets, presentations, and images. Files remain ordinary files in the
locations you choose.

This beta provides a Linux amd64 binary. Download the archive and
`checksums.txt`, verify the checksum with `sha256sum -c checksums.txt`, and
extract the archive to install `parchment`. See the
[installation guide](https://github.com/ramjac/parchment/blob/v0.5.0-beta.1/README.md#install)
for complete instructions.

**Beta:** Artifact formats may change without backward-compatibility
guarantees. Back up your files before using this release or upgrading.
